summary: A clerk's wrong filing date leaves several candidates off a ballot, and the officials say state law allows no extension.
realLife: In one city a clerk's mistaken date meant mayoral candidates missed the cutoff, and the city looked to a court to let them on; in another city a candidate said his confirmation listed the earlier deadline and he was told his signatures fell short.
sources: Michigan Public, Flint voters may have to write in a mayor, May 4, 2015: https://www.michiganpublic.org/politics-government/2015-05-04/flint-voters-might-have-to-write-in-name-of-the-next-mayor-in-november
KALW, mayoral hopeful left off ballot blames clerk's office, Aug. 24, 2022: https://www.kalw.org/kalw-news/2022-08-24/oakland-mayoral-hopeful-left-off-ballot-blames-city-clerks-office
